threads.name: The treasure map
threads.note: The party follows a treasure map whose marked locations they do not recognize, and the treasure's location is still unknown.

threads.name: The Clurichen of the riverbanks
threads.note: Reginald warned of a trickster creature that comes into town from the riverbanks every night, a danger that stands apart from the other threads.

threads.name: The dragon and the Reeve's bounty
threads.note: A black dragon troubles Brandonsford and Eric the Reeve offers 1000 gold for its body. The dragon still lives, and Farmer Gill's sons are already hunting it.

threads.name: Hiring Lady Hilda
threads.note: Lady Hilda offered to join an adventuring party against the dragon for money, and Sir Phidipaldi said they would return to take up her services after seeing the Reeve (beat_10).

threads.name: Drop Dead Ned's offer
threads.note: Drop Dead Ned offered himself and his killer wasp for hire at 100 gold a week, and Dr. Uriah is still thinking it over.

threads.name: Brandonsford's missing shipments
threads.note: Nothing has come into town in months and Bentley's restock never arrived, hurting the whole town. The cause is unknown.

threads.name: Sir Phidipaldi's quarrel with Eric the Reeve
threads.note: Sir Phidipaldi insulted Eric and challenged him to a duel at dawn, and Bentley expelled him for the night over it (beat_22). The challenge is unresolved.

threads.name: Shamus the mule
threads.note: Farmer Gill offered Shamus for 100 gold, and Dunk asked about trading work instead. Dunk is sleeping on the offer in Gill's barn.

threads.name: Warwick's mithril chain shirt
threads.note: Warwick displays a superb mithril shirt that would fit a normal-sized person but always refuses to sell it, leaving a coveted item still out of reach.

threads.name: Quinn's revenge on Bentley
threads.note: Quinn's stock vanishes nightly and he blames Bentley. Sir Phidipaldi agreed to stage a fake ale delivery for 100 gold and has not yet done so (beat_37).
